response.rationale: C1 is the most complete: it combines the pancreaticopleural fistula mechanism (pleural amylase 11,871 U/L, dark brown turbid fluid) with the left-sided anatomy (massive left pleural effusion). R3 has the correct mechanism but omits laterality; R4 and R1 name only pancreatic pathology and do not explain the massive left pleural effusion.

rejected.why: Chronic pancreatitis is an underlying predisposition but does not explain the high-amylase left pleural effusion; CT lacks duct dilation/calcifications.
Pseudocyst is a local pancreatic finding and possible fistula source, but the dominant presentation is a massive left pleural effusion with pleural fluid amylase 11,871 U/L.
